input: Check if my rental deposit was returned in full

gold.taskTitle: Verify Rental Deposit Was Returned in Full
gold.taskDescription: Confirm whether the full rental deposit amount was returned by the landlord or property manager after vacating the property.

questions.title: What was the exact deposit amount you paid?
questions.description: Establish the precise figure the user originally paid as a deposit.

questions.title: How much money have you actually received back?
questions.description: Find out what amount, if any, has already been returned to the user.

questions.title: When did you officially move out of the property?
questions.description: Determine the move-out date to understand the timeline and any legal deadlines for deposit return.

questions.title: Was the refund sent by bank transfer, cheque, or cash?
questions.description: Clarify the payment method used so the right account or document can be checked.

questions.title: Did your landlord mention any deductions from the deposit?
questions.description: Find out if any deductions for cleaning, damage, or unpaid rent were communicated.

questions.title: Is the deposit held by a government-backed protection scheme?
questions.description: Determine whether the deposit is registered with a tenancy deposit scheme, which affects dispute options.

questions.title: Do you still have your original tenancy agreement and deposit receipt?
questions.description: Check whether the user has documentation to support a claim or comparison.
